messages:
Anna (CS): Hey team — we just got 3 quickstart drop-in requests flagged as renewal-risk. Can we carve out a single "priority" slot this Friday to handle them back-to-back?

Mike (Solutions): Which accounts are those? Do we have PM PST availability? :thinking: 

Anna (CS): NovaHealth, Kestrel, Meridian. All asked for hands-on walkthroughs. Renewal conversations start next month if not onboarded.

Sanjay (CSM): I can take NovaHealth. Prefer Fri 15:00 PDT. Can we do 1hr focused sessions (pre-read + guided lab)?

Eli (Facilitator): I can run the sessions but need a co-host for breakout help and screen recording. @Mike can you co-host the first two?

Mike (Solutions): Yup I can co-host at 15:00. Proposed format: 10m intros + 30m guided demo + 15m hands-on + 5m wrap. Recording + notes.

Anna (CS): Sounds good. Also want enablement-bot to mark the event as "priority-enablement" so BizOps queues don't auto-fill.

enablement-bot: Created priority slot: "Quickstart Priority - Fri 15:00 PDT" — calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/e/PRIORITY-98643 

Jen (BizOps): I'm adding a soft hold on the public drop-in calendar and tagging the three accounts as "priority-enablement" in our queue. I'll also attach the cancellation policy and recording ownership.

Sanjay (CSM): Kestrel asked for an EMEA-friendly time too. Can we offer a fallback Fri 08:00 GMT for them?

Eli (Facilitator): I can do the fallback for Kestrel 08:00 GMT. We'll reuse the same agenda but shorten Q&A if needed.

Anna (CS): Perfect. After each session, please complete the post-session readiness form: https://forms.redwood.com/quickstart-feedback and prefix the entry with "PRIORITY:" so we can triage follow-ups.

Mike (Solutions): Also note: disable auto-queueing for the priority slot so it doesn't pick up other customers. @Jen can you confirm the soft hold prevents auto-assign?

Jen (BizOps): Confirmed — soft hold in place and auto-assign paused for that block. I'm also drafting a two-page runbook for handling priority slots (who to ping, recording naming convention, tagging in Gainsight). Draft here: https://docs.redwood.com/priority-runbook (comments welcome).

Anna (CS): Thanks all. I'll send the invite list, pre-read, and a slim agenda by EOD. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can make the Fri 15:00 PDT slot.
